description:
No C2C Please.


Key Deliverables:


As Front End Developer the successful candidate will be 
responsible for developing high quality, well documented, defect free 
code.

The successful candidate will work with the project manager and team
 leads to meet deliverables and ensure we are developing world class 
applications as well working with the project architect to develop to 
industry and company standards.

We will look to the Front End Developer to suggest technologies and 
techniques that result in functional, accessible and maintainable user 
facing applications which meet customer and business needs.

You will work as part of a strong, close knit team and contribute to a positive team working environment and team.


Preferred experience and technology requirements:


Very strong JavaScript and functional programming (3+ years)

Strong web front end development skills (HTML5/CSS3)

Experience developing single page web applications supported by separate REST APIs

Experience with AngularJS, jQuery, bootstrap is a plus

Experience with Mobile application development (iOS, Android) is a plus

Experience with Front End unit testing and debugging experience is a plus

Experience with Graphic and visual design experience is a plus

A background in Educational Technology background and/or Healthcare/nursing is beneficial. 



 Skill : html5/css3, REST APIs, mobile development, iOS, android


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
